capabilities: Show backlinks as whole blocks with expandable breadcrumb context
Edit backlink blocks in place and write changes back to the note
Filter, sort and group backlinks by co-mentions, aliases and text
Compute word and word-pair statistics over a note's backlinks
Export a note to PDF together with its backlinks
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a Roam import or sync tool; it reshapes Obsidian's own backlinks panel.
extras: Not yet approved for the community plugin store; installable via BRAT or manual download. It modifies the built-in Backlinks panel and Export to PDF dialog at runtime, so Obsidian updates may temporarily break features; PDF export is desktop only.
intentEvidence: This plugin focuses on making Obsidian's own panel work like Logseq and Roam Research
motivation: The author built it for users who used Logseq or Roam Research and miss whole-block backlinks they can read and edit in place, which Obsidian's own panel does not provide.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks panel shows only a line or two of plain text around each link, with no block context and no way to edit a mention without leaving the page.

relations.evidence: List blocks zoom in with the Zoom plugin when installed.
Emacs Logseq Inspired Outline, which adds Shift-click for links in the editor
Edit your backlinks in place, block by block, the way Logseq and Roam Research do it.
Folding like Logseq. First-level children are listed; deeper children fold behind a

summary: Backlinks enhancer that shows whole blocks with breadcrumbs, edits them in place, and adds co-mention filtering, word stats and PDF export with backlinks.
